newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures drop to moderate losses.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures drop to moderate losses.

text.p: April 23 - U.S. debt futures fell to moderate losses, fresh day's lows, as volume picked up. Some brokers tied erosion to failure of June T-bonds to return above the 108-03/32 level despite a solid 5-yr year note auction. Some brokers also noted a wire service story that Atlanta Fed president Guynn said if wait for signs of inflation, will be behind the curve.
